topic: The Dark Knight — The Joker's Psychological Trap

beats.narration_text: Look closely at what the Joker does during this interrogation.
beats.scene_description: Joker sits calmly under the interrogation lamp, smiling eerily across the metal table.

beats.narration_text: Batman thinks he's asking the questions.
beats.scene_description: Batman towers over the Joker in heavy shadow, asserting physical dominance.

beats.narration_text: But the Joker is controlling the conversation.
beats.scene_description: Extreme close-up of the Joker leaning forward, grinning as he dismantles Batman's authority.

beats.narration_text: He reveals that Harvey Dent and Rachel are in danger.
beats.scene_description: Joker gesticulates with handcuffed hands, calmly announcing the hostages are rigged to die.

beats.narration_text: Then he gives Batman two locations.
beats.scene_description: Joker names the two separate locations: 250 52nd Street and Avenue X at Cicero.
Joker locks eyes with Batman, highlighting the simultaneous countdown timers.
Shock and sudden realization register across Batman's face as the moral trap springs.

beats.narration_text: And that's exactly what the Joker wants.
beats.scene_description: Joker bursts into manic laughter against the tiled wall, revelling in Batman's dilemma.

beats.narration_text: He isn't simply trying to make Batman angry.
beats.scene_description: Batman pins Joker against the two-way mirror; physical violence cannot break Joker's psychological game.

beats.narration_text: He's forcing Batman into a situation where even doing the right thing means someone gets hurt.
beats.scene_description: Joker's face close-up: You have nothing to threaten me with. The moral bind is total.

beats.narration_text: The real trap isn't the room.
beats.scene_description: Batman breaks away from the interrogation room, slamming open the heavy security door.
Batman sprints through the GCPD bullpen into the night; held final frame with concluding text card.
